title: Murder of Priyadarshini Mattoo
narrative: FIR — 23 January 1996, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi. Priyadarshini Mattoo, a 25-year-old law student, was raped, struck repeatedly with a motorcycle helmet and strangled with an electric wire at her uncle's residence. The accused was Santosh Kumar Singh, a college senior and son of a senior police officer. Evidence included the helmet with a shattered visor and DNA testing. The Central Bureau of Investigation investigated. He was acquitted in 1999, convicted by the Delhi High Court in 2006 and given life imprisonment by the Supreme Court in 2010.
